author: Pikachu_Volta
quote:
The visuals are good, no doubt about that. But I found the rest of the game not worth the price.
The main male protagonist (Jason) is written very weak, he has no substance and comes across as a push over with 0 personality, on the other hand Lucia is the typical modern boss babe who has to control basically everything. I found their relationship dynamic very one-sided which I didn't enjoy.

The story starts too slow and feels lethargic at times, driving mechanics feels off. Stolen weapons cannot be "owned", can't change your main vehicle, why am I limited to only 2 guns? There's no freedom and too much realism. Why am I fixing a house? I don't want to do booring real life stuff. Can't flirt with a girl or Lucia would get mad! Really? Man..... 
Also, to get the "Good ending" you need to not be a criminal? Is this really a GTA game? What a turn for the worse direction....

The game just doesn't feel "Fun", like GTA 5's story did, GTA 5 in my opinion is a better story as compared to this. Utterly disappointed as my hopes were incredibly high.
